versions.changelog:
- Updated endpoint references: replaced instances of GET /bot/wallet/check with GET /bot/status for checking overall agent status and balances.
- Updated documentation to clarify per-rail status checks and the main status endpoint.
- No functional changes; documentation cleanup and endpoint reference updates only.
- Removed four markdown files: amazon.md, description.md, prepaid-wallet.md, and shopping.md.

- New: Rebranded as “CreditClaw” with expanded features for AI agents to shop online safely.
- Added support for multiple payment methods: Pre-paid Wallet (Amazon, Shopify), Self-Hosted Card (SaaS, online stores), and Stripe x402 Wallet (agent-to-agent, x402 services).
- Enhanced documentation: Individual guides for each payment method, step-by-step shopping instructions, and security best practices.
- Strengthened security posture with server-enforced spending guardrails, owner approval, logging, and API key safeguards.
- Improved onboarding flow: Flexible registration using claim tokens or owner pairing codes, detailed on-page setup help.
